summary: Warnings for Vemurafenib include monitoring for new skin cancers, which requires skin checks before starting, every two months during treatment, and for up to six months after stopping [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than human testing, the drug has a high liver score and a low heart score [M]. Multiple clinical trials combining Vemurafenib with other drugs were stopped early or limited because of high toxicity [5][6][7].
